facts.text: I've had a cough that won't go away.
It's a dry cough; I don't bring anything up.

facts.item: when the cough and breathlessness started
facts.text: The cough and breathlessness started after I had a cold about a month ago.
Before this, my health was generally good.
I recently got back from a month-long trip to St. Louis, Missouri.
I don't have any other symptoms apart from the cough and breathlessness.

findings.name: chest examination
findings.result: Inspection: no visible deformities. Auscultation: normal breath sounds without wheezes or rhonchi. Percussion: mild dullness on the right side. Palpation: mild crepitus on the right side.

findings.name: chest X-ray
findings.result: Cavitary lesion in the right lung.

findings.name: chest CT
findings.result: Confirms the cavitary lesion seen on the chest X-ray.

findings.name: lung biopsy
findings.result: Necrotic granulomatous inflammation with oval yeast bodies within macrophages.

x005: 'Mild crepitus' on chest palpation is unusual for this picture (it normally means subcutaneous emphysema); kept as given.
x007: The CT result refers back to the chest X-ray and adds no own description; if the doctor orders CT without an X-ray, the result still points to an X-ray finding.

source_issues: The chest CT result has no independent description ('Confirmation of the cavitary lesion seen on X-ray').
Chest palpation reports 'mild crepitus', which is atypical (possibly meant crackles on auscultation, which is reported as normal).
notes: 'Non-productive' is an absent child of the cough (f002). The onset after a cold about a month ago applies to the cough and the breathlessness, so it is a standalone fact citing the history and 'History of a recent cold' (p003).
'Describes previous health as generally good' is f005 (absent health problems before this illness); her hypertension and hyperlipidemia are recorded separately as in the source.
p004 lists three drugs without saying which treats which; each drug is one medication fact and the texts do not assign indications (aliases only).
'No other symptoms apart from those mentioned' (p006) is a denial of other symptoms (f014).
Fixes: f008 alias 'blood pressure medication' removed; f009 alias 'blood pressure medication' removed.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with a persistent non-productive cough and dyspnea following a recent cold.
